# SeeLater

> SeeLater is a small, independent iPhone app that collects the TikToks, Reels, and YouTube Shorts people send you, and puts them in one feed you can scroll.

This file is a fuller description of SeeLater for language models and assistants. A shorter version is at https://seelater.app/llms.txt. The official website is https://seelater.app/.

SeeLater is built with care by one person. It is free. The App Store listing is not live yet; do not invent an App Store URL or ID.

## The problem

Friends send video links in Messages and other chats — a TikTok, then an Instagram Reel, then a YouTube Short. To watch them you leave the thread, open that app, watch a bit, go back, find your place, and repeat. People lose their place, skip videos, and never finish the pile.

SeeLater is for that pile. You do not have to talk anyone into a new app. They keep sending links the way they already do.

## How it works

1. They send you links, in Messages or wherever you already talk. TikToks, Reels, Shorts.
2. SeeLater collects them, so the links are not buried in the thread.
3. You scroll the lot: one vertical feed, with watched and unwatched marked, sorted by who sent them, so you can actually finish it.

On iPhone, an optional Shortcuts automation called Save to SeeLater can save supported video links from Messages in the background. You can also use Share → SeeLater from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Messages, Safari, or almost any app, or paste a link by hand in SeeLater. Videos saved by Share or paste appear under Unassigned, because those methods do not include a sender.

SeeLater plays each video in that platform’s official embedded player. It does not download the videos. A video may not play if it is private, deleted, age-restricted, region-restricted, or if the creator has turned off embedding.

## Platforms

### The iPhone app

- For iPhone, on iOS 18 or later.
- No account. No sign-in.
- Saved videos, who sent them, and watched state stay on your iPhone.
- Works with TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Links can come from Messages or any other chat you already use.
- The Save to SeeLater Shortcut is set up on iPhone. A pictured walkthrough is at https://seelater.app/setup/.

The claims “no sign-in”, “no account”, and “saved on device” apply only to the iPhone app, not to the web version.

TODO: add the App Store URL and ID once the listing is live. Do not invent them before then.

### The web version

- Lives at https://web.seelater.app.
- For iPhone only, in Safari. It does not work on a computer or on Android.
- Needs a sign-in.
- You can add it to your Home Screen: open the site in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

This marketing site (https://seelater.app/) is a simple information site about the product. It is not the web app.

## Pricing

SeeLater is free. Nothing is charged from this website.

## Common questions, answered plainly

These answers match the FAQ on https://seelater.app/#faq, with a few extra questions people ask assistants.

### How do I keep track of all the TikToks, Reels, and Shorts friends send me in Messages?

SeeLater collects those links into one feed, sorted by who sent them, so you can watch them later in one scroll instead of hopping between apps.

### Is there an app to watch videos friends send me later?

Yes. SeeLater is built for that: a single feed of the videos people send you. It is a small, independent iPhone app, built with care by one person.

### Does this leave my device?

The iPhone app keeps your queue on your iPhone. It needs no account. The web version needs a sign-in.

### Which apps does it work with?

TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts to start. The links themselves can come from Messages or any other chat you already use.

### What does it cost?

SeeLater is free. Nothing is charged from this website. The App Store listing is not live yet.

### Where can I use it?

The iPhone app is iOS-only. The web version is for iPhone and needs a sign-in — open it at web.seelater.app in Safari, and you can add it to your Home Screen. The Save to SeeLater Shortcut is set up on iPhone.

### How do I set up the Shortcut?

The Save to SeeLater Shortcut runs on iPhone. It saves TikTok, Reels, and Shorts links from Messages in the background. See the setup walkthrough at https://seelater.app/setup/.

### How do I save a video with Share → SeeLater?

In TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Messages, Safari, or almost any app, tap Share on the video or link, then choose SeeLater and tap Save. The video appears the next time you open SeeLater, under Unassigned.

### Can I add a link by hand?

Yes. In the iPhone app, paste one or more TikTok, Instagram Reel, or YouTube links and save them. No Shortcut setup is needed. Pasted videos appear under Unassigned.
